CurrencyUnitCreateRequest.description:
Request payload for creating a currency unit.

`currency_code` is normalized to uppercase, so "inr" is stored as "INR".
`minor_unit` is the number of decimal places defined by ISO 4217
(0 to 4); null means ISO 4217 defines none ("N.A.").
CurrencyUnitCreateRequest.title: CurrencyUnitCreateRequest

CurrencyUnitOption.description:
Compact currency unit used to fill currency drop-downs (e.g. the room
type cost field).
CurrencyUnitOption.title: CurrencyUnitOption

CurrencyUnitUpdateRequest.description:
Request payload for updating the currency unit identified by `guid`.
Takes the same fields as `CurrencyUnitCreateRequest`.
CurrencyUnitUpdateRequest.title: CurrencyUnitUpdateRequest

OrganizationAdminMappingRequest.description:
Admin-only umbrella endpoint: assign/replace the OWNER or MANAGER
mapping on any organization.
OrganizationAdminMappingRequest.title: OrganizationAdminMappingRequest

OrganizationCreateAdminRequest.description:
Request payload for creating or updating an organization as an Admin.

When `guid` is omitted, a new organization is created and `owner_user_guid`
is required to establish the initial OWNER mapping. When `guid` is
present, the organization is updated; `owner_user_guid` is ignored on
update (ownership transfer is performed via `/organization/owner`).
OrganizationCreateAdminRequest.title: OrganizationCreateAdminRequest

OrganizationCreateOwnerRequest.description:
Request payload for an Owner to create or update their own organization.
The authenticated Owner is automatically associated as OWNER on create.
OrganizationCreateOwnerRequest.title: OrganizationCreateOwnerRequest

OrganizationManagerMappingRequest.description:
Assign (`is_active=True`) or remove (`is_active=False`) a MANAGER
mapping on an organization.
OrganizationManagerMappingRequest.title: OrganizationManagerMappingRequest

OrganizationMembershipSummary.description:
Lightweight view of an organization the caller is actively mapped to.
Used to resolve and display the caller's active organization.
OrganizationMembershipSummary.title: OrganizationMembershipSummary

OrganizationOwnerMappingRequest.description: Assign or replace the OWNER mapping on an organization. Admin-only.
OrganizationOwnerMappingRequest.title: OrganizationOwnerMappingRequest

OrganizationReference.description: Minimal public reference to an organization (e.g. the owner of a record).
OrganizationReference.title: OrganizationReference

OrganizationRole.description:
Role of a user within an organization, derived from the user's
``usersreplica`` record.

Attributes
----------
OWNER : int
    Owns the organization. Every organization must have at least one
    active OWNER mapping at all times.
    Value: 1
MANAGER : int
    Delegated day-to-day management access to the organization, granted
    by an Admin or Owner. Read-only with respect to organization
    create/update/delete operations.
    Value: 2

Notes
-----
Values differ from `UserType` (the role stored on ``usersreplica``), so
never compare the two directly; convert with `user_type` /
`from_user_type` instead.
OrganizationRole.title: OrganizationRole

OrganizationTypeUpsertRequest.description:
Request payload for creating or updating an organization type.

When `guid` is omitted (or null), a new organization type is created.
When `guid` is present, the existing organization type identified by
that guid is updated.
OrganizationTypeUpsertRequest.title: OrganizationTypeUpsertRequest

RoomAmenityCreateRequest.description:
Request payload for creating a room amenity.

`organization_guid` is read only for admins: null creates a default
amenity offered to every organization, a value creates a custom
amenity of that organization. Owners and managers always create custom
amenities of their active organization.
RoomAmenityCreateRequest.title: RoomAmenityCreateRequest

RoomAmenityOption.description:
Compact room amenity offered for selection (e.g. room type amenity
check boxes).
RoomAmenityOption.title: RoomAmenityOption

RoomAmenityUpdateRequest.description:
Request payload for updating the room amenity identified by `guid`.
An amenity's scope (default or owning organization) never changes.
RoomAmenityUpdateRequest.title: RoomAmenityUpdateRequest

RoomCreateRequest.description:
Request payload for creating a room.

`organization_guid` is read only for admins, who must choose the
organization; owners and managers always create rooms in their active
organization. `status` defaults to "available".
RoomCreateRequest.title: RoomCreateRequest

RoomResponse.description: A room with its room type and organization.
RoomResponse.title: RoomResponse

RoomStatus.description:
Operational status of a room. Stored as text in `rooms.status`.

Attributes
----------
AVAILABLE : str
    The room can be used. Default for new rooms.
UNDER_MAINTENANCE : str
    The room is temporarily unusable (cleaning, repairs).
OUT_OF_SERVICE : str
    The room is not in use until further notice.
RoomStatus.title: RoomStatus

RoomTypeCreateRequest.description:
Request payload for creating a room type.

`organization_guid` is read only for admins, who must choose the
organization; owners and managers always create room types in their
active organization.
RoomTypeCreateRequest.title: RoomTypeCreateRequest

RoomTypeOption.description:
Compact room type offered for selection (e.g. the room form's room type
drop-down) and embedded in room responses.
RoomTypeOption.title: RoomTypeOption

RoomTypeResponse.description:
A room type with its currency and amenities.

`cost_per_night` is serialized as a decimal string (e.g. "1500.00") so
no precision is lost in JSON.
RoomTypeResponse.title: RoomTypeResponse

RoomTypeUpdateRequest.description:
Request payload for updating the room type identified by `guid`.
A room type never moves to another organization.
RoomTypeUpdateRequest.title: RoomTypeUpdateRequest

RoomUpdateRequest.description:
Request payload for updating the room identified by `guid`.
A room never moves to another organization.
RoomUpdateRequest.title: RoomUpdateRequest
